Procedural note: early in the run three throwaway listing scripts (scan/listing helpers, no reference parsing) were briefly written to scratchpad/eval/tools/ outside the annotations directory; they were deleted before any annotation was written and all later code ran inline from stdin.

identifiers.notes: Publisher (IOP) URL in مسار (url=) whose path is /article/<DOI> rather than /doi/<DOI>. Read as a publisher URL pointing at the identifier, so the whole URL is quoted. The DOI runs to the end of the URL. Alternative reading: quote only the DOI text at cp+35.
Inside an archive.org snapshot URL (another site's URL, مسار أرشيف); quoted the embedded URL. Not a target.
Field written in upper case as DOI=. Key lower-cases X.

unresolved_notes: The infobox {{معلومات كوكب}} (cp 0) emits a Wikidata-generated reference (rendered as cite_note-wikidata-…-1 with 10 markers cite_ref-wikidata-…_1-0…9; body: minorplanetcenter.net URL with a CS1 error). It has no source location and is not listed (guide 3.3).
"* {{JPL small body}}" under وصلات خارجية renders an external link to the JPL Small-Body Database (no citation template, no DOI/PMID). Not treated as a bibliography entry.
{{مراجع}} is the references-list template without refs=; no list-defined references.
